headline: Sudarshan Chemical Industries: SEBI Takeover Disclosure Filed
sum: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd has filed a Regulation 10(5) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding or control event requiring public disclosure to the NSE.
implication: A Reg 10(5) disclosure flags either a mandatory open offer threshold breach (≥25% in listed company) or an acquisition triggering takeover norms; counsel should immediately verify the acquirer's identity, acquisition date, and whether a full open offer under Regulation 26 is mandated.
detail: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd (SUDARCOLOR on NSE) submitted a formal disclosure of substantial acquisition to the stock exchange under SEBI's takeover framework. Regulation 10(5) requires disclosure when a person acquires shares or voting rights in a listed company such that their holding crosses a disclosure threshold (typically 25%, 35%, 50%, 75%) or on announcement of an acquisition of control. The specific acquirer identity, acquisition structure (share purchase, open market, negotiated deal), consideration, conditions precedent and regulatory gate items (CCI approval if applicable, foreign investment screening) remain to be corroborated from the filed disclosure document or company press release.
